name: Recruiting Reports
description: Recruiting benchmark data from 30+ industry reports, covering hiring metrics, time-to-fill, and compensation.

tools.name: list_reports
tools.description: List all available recruiting industry reports with a summary of what data each covers.

tools.name: read_report
tools.description: Read the full content of a specific report. Use list_reports first to see available names.

tools.name: search_reports
tools.description: Full-text keyword search across all report bodies (and titles/authors/best-for blurbs from frontmatter). Returns matching excerpts with surrounding context. Use for topical questions like 'reports about AI adoption' or specific metrics like 'time-to-fill'.

query.description: Keyword or short phrase, e.g. 'time-to-fill', 'hires per recruiter', 'ghost job'.

tools.name: get_stat
tools.description: Alias of search_reports phrased as a metric lookup â looks up where a specific benchmark stat appears across all reports. Returns excerpts with context.

metric.description: Metric phrase, e.g. 'hires per recruiter', 'candidate NPS', 'offer acceptance rate'.

tools.name: search_quotes
tools.description: Find direct quotes from the reports. Optionally filter by a keyword or topic. Returns each quote with its source report and attribution context.

filter.description: Optional keyword to narrow results, e.g. 'AI', 'candidate experience'. Omit to return all quotes.

tools.name: filter_reports
tools.description: Return the LIST of reports matching structured filters (source, year, year_min/year_max). Does NOT return report content â tells you WHICH reports exist for a slice. Then use read_report to read one, or search_reports to query their text. For topical questions ('about AI'), use search_reports instead.

source.description: Canonical source name. Case-insensitive substring match (e.g. 'Ashby', 'gem', 'LinkedIn'). See server instructions for the full source list.
